title: Issi ben Shammai
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.

paragraphs: He is mentioned in the Mekhilta, Beshalach, Massekhta deShirah, chapter 2, and there, Massekhta deVayassa, end of chapter 3. The Gra reads Issi ben Yehudah, as cited in Yoma 76a.

notes.text: The consulted digital witnesses differ in both numbering and patronymic: the Wikisource Vayassa text has Asei bar Shammai in the saying that all nations saw Israel’s manna; the parallel at Sefaria Vayassa 4:18 has Asei ben Akubah in the Beeri Hebrew and Issi ben Yehudah in the Silverstein English. Hyman cites the end of chapter 3. His attribution of the Yehudah reading to the Gra is retained without claiming an independent collation of that apparatus; these readings do not themselves establish identity.
